title: Changing the distribution can help
headline: 4.13 → 9.16 Mops/s
meaning: In NFL’s Table 1, ALEX on Facebook has lower tree height and higher throughput after applying NF.

title: The transform has a query-time price
headline: 169.53 ns/key → 8.38 ns/key
meaning: The same 2H2L NF’s average transformation cost per key changes sharply with batching: size 1 versus size 256.

title: Virtual points trade preprocessing for better queries
headline: Up to 34% lower query time
meaning: CSV reports this maximum for promoted keys, not an unconditional query sample over the entire index.

title: Learned compression is already prior art
headline: Up to 16% higher throughput
meaning: LeCo reports this RocksDB Seek result versus the second-best tested configuration (§5.2), not for our in-memory map.

title: Our existing pilot exposes a memory / speed trade-off
headline: 16.628 → 11.249 bytes/record
meaning: Raw/rank versus packed/byte uses less accounted memory, but throughput falls from 7.402 to 4.622 million ops/s in this small archived experiment.

title: A straighter curve is not automatically a better search
headline: Lower MSE; higher block error
meaning: Density-target smoothing beats minimum-byte layout on normalized byte MSE, but loses on initial block displacement and encoded size.

title: The Mac run is a successful pilot, not a SOTA score
headline: 0.458 µs median insert; 253.958 µs P99
meaning: The supplied run passed verification and recorded 47 synchronous compactions. Ordinary writes and rebuild-triggering writes have very different costs.
